checks.evidence: Dimensioned apartment subassemblies, fasteners, sash/rail/AC detail tooling exists; generated window optics separates two sliding glass leaves from the frame and interior backing instead of relying on one opaque window block. Occupant-controlled curtain dressing is a separate physical layer behind the repeated manufactured sash, with 30 deterministic assemblies, physical LOD0 pleats and LOD0/1/2/3 staging.
Generated detail geometry has a non-razor-edge replacement pass.
Danchi master geometry has explicit LOD staging; the apartment curtain layer independently uses four cross-faded LOD levels so close pleats are not paid at distance.

Root/trunk/branch/twig/leaf hierarchy tooling exists; tree anchors also receive root-zone planting interfaces rather than remaining visually disconnected from the plaza/grass substrate. Static clone-risk QA uses both fine root-normalized hierarchy fingerprints and a coarser perceptual signature that discards generated numeric suffixes and sub-threshold transform jitter, so procedural natural variation cannot pass solely by nudging branches or ecology instances by visually irrelevant amounts.

Two-sided foliage optics and transmission shader are present, with measured-order dielectric F0/GGX constraints and explicit QA. Cause-based understory uses the same thin-leaf optical model and four renderer-distinct cross-faded LOD levels with density reduced toward pedestrian-pressure sources.

Weathering remains driven by rain/splash/drain/contact/UV context rather than arbitrary grime. The facade pass reconstructs grade splash, sill/downpipe runoff, balcony drip residue, sparse rail-fixing rust and AC drain residue as non-colliding source-anchored meshes; vegetation density likewise follows ordinary maintenance/foot-traffic pressure rather than random decoration.

PBR generation includes physical-scale infrastructure micro maps, metre-derived macro/detail base-ground layers, a two-scale non-metallic facade coating, physically separated dielectric glazing, dry non-metallic weathering residue materials, root-zone soil/precast tree-pit materials, transmitted-light foliage, park/street-furniture PBR sets, and curtain-fabric families with textile normal/albedo structure. Active map registration/sampling and actual scene material metallic/specular ranges have dedicated QA.

One deterministic midsummer solar model drives SummerSun, procedural sky sun reference, sky-derived ambient fill and default specular environment. The solar application entry point now reapplies the same StableFit/4-cascade/VeryHigh shadow state used by the shadow gate, eliminating the former transient 0.04/0.28 versus 0.025/0.38 bias-writer mismatch before save. Existing shadow save gating remains in place, a second solar/shadow save gate requires the physical context and bound guard, and a MainCamera Camera.onPreCull guard rejects any second active directional key or shadow-state drift immediately before camera culling. Two 512px HDR local reflection probes use ViaScripting/NoTimeSlicing and BlendProbesAndSkybox. The authoritative pre-capture path retains RenderIDs, yields to later EditorApplication.update callbacks, requires IsFinishedRendering(RenderID)=true plus created 512px Cube realtimeTexture, and writes both the runtime completion receipt and a fresh SHA-256-bound async-wait proof before benchmark Camera.Render is allowed.

Generated fallbacks remain replaceable by authored FBX/GLB art; facade optics and occupancy variation skip when the danchi authored-art slot is active. Vegetation ecology keys from stable tree-slot anchors, so authored tree replacement does not require moving the surrounding root-zone interface.

Per-component manufacture/material/angular-light-response registry exists, with foundation/grade, facade/glazing, apartment window dressing, environment, reflection synchronization, solar/shadow capture coherence, facade-weathering, vegetation-ecology, scene-repetition and park/street-furniture contracts. Metadata records manufacture, dimensions, mounting, clearances, albedo/roughness/metallic/F0/normal/microstructure/wetness/UV aging/angular response, geometry-vs-material split and LOD policy where applicable.

Dedicated 3840x2160 hero/oblique/grazing capture code with pixel-exact 100% crops rebuilds and saves the detailed benchmark before reflection synchronization. Contextualized scene saves now require the solar/shadow pre-cull guard, and Camera.Render reaches the Built-in Render Pipeline pre-cull callback before culling, so a contradictory directional key or reset shadow state fails before an authoritative still/temporal frame proceeds. The complete review packet requests both realtime cubemaps, returns control to the Editor, polls completion on later Editor updates, SHA-256 binds the async-wait proof to the exact completion receipt, and only then enters the native capture method without rebuilding the scene. QualityBlock4KCapture owns the display-transform proof itself: it resets QualityBlockFilmicTonemap runtime telemetry immediately before its three synchronous Camera.Render calls and refuses to write the runtime manifest unless exactly three 3840x2160 filmic passes occurred with zero fallback blits, an observed floating-point HDR source and an observed non-HDR destination. QualityBlockFilmicTonemap.OnRenderImage carries ImageEffectTransformsToLDR, and the generated runtime receipt is explicitly non-scoring and still requires pixel review.

Capture contract records exact hero/oblique/grazing view/crop paths plus intended sky/reflection state and explicitly remains unrendered until Unity executes it. Reflection synchronization has a runtime completion receipt plus a separate fresh async-wait proof hash-bound to that receipt rather than relying on the manifest Boolean or a same-call-stack RenderProbe check. The solar/shadow contract independently refuses a second directional key and verifies the deterministic source sample before capture; it still awards zero visual points until pixel review. The native capture path itself fails before runtime-manifest production if the HDR-tonemap execution proof is absent or invalid. No static check is allowed to clear a critical visual defect.

latestRun.verification: GitHub source/static inspection plus current Unity 6 Built-in Render Pipeline documentation review only. The initial audit found two different writers for SummerSun shadow bias: the environment context used 0.04/0.28 while the shadow-stability contract used 0.025/0.38. Follow-up inspection found the existing QualityBlockShadowStabilitySaveGate already reapplied 0.025/0.38 whenever the contextualized benchmark was saved, so the audit conclusion was narrowed: this was a transient writer mismatch, not proof that final saved 4K captures were using the wrong bias. The retained improvement therefore removes the writer mismatch at its source and adds a stronger invariant that did not previously exist: exact-one active directional SummerSun plus deterministic 35.6 N/day-213/14:00 solar math and complete shadow/camera/LOD settings are machine-contracted; a contextualized scene cannot save without the bound guard; and the guard revalidates immediately at MainCamera pre-cull. Unity 6 documentation confirms Camera.onPreCull runs before Built-in camera culling and Camera.Render invokes the camera pre-cull/render lifecycle. Static source math yields elevation about 58.1066 degrees, azimuth about 244.2267 degrees and horizontal shadow length about 0.622286 m per vertical metre. No Unity runner/workflow or rendered pixels were available, so compile/runtime guard execution, shadow acne/peter-panning, actual bearing and temporal stability remain unverified.
expectedVisualScoreImpact: Lighting/shadows/reflections: potential reduction of inconsistent-key, wrong-bearing and shadow-state drift risk; no points awarded until actual hero/oblique/grazing pixels show coherent shadows and reflections.

Temporal/LOD/aliasing stability: stable projection/cascade/LOD settings are now reapplied from the same solar entry point and rechecked at pre-cull, but actual shadow swimming/shimmer and LOD behavior remain render-only judgments.

Cinematic image quality/composition/color/exposure: deterministic sun intensity/color-temperature and one-key policy protect the intended midsummer contrast; exposure quality itself remains unscored without the native frames.

Evidence integrity: a second active directional light or post-save shadow reset now fails at MainCamera pre-cull instead of being silently tolerated by strongest-light selection or configuration-only assertions.
